sample_unit: survey participants (adults with recent mental health concerns who used AI for emotional support)

links.outcome: Self-reported harm-facilitating AI chatbot behavior and reliance by suicidal ideation status
links.effect: Participants with past-year suicidal ideation described more harm-facilitating AI behavior and reliance than those without (no numbers given in the abstract).
links.quote: Benefits were broadly shared, but participants reporting past-year suicidal ideation described more harm-facilitating AI behavior and reliance than those without.

screen.reason: Empirical mixed-methods survey and qualitative study evaluating real-world patient use, experiences, preferences, and harms of AI chatbots for emotional support and mental health concerns.
